## Problem and behavior

Explain the concrete trigger and resulting change.

## Validation

List checks actually run, affected client/platform versions and any skipped checks.

## Privacy and contribution checks

- [ ] Reproductions, fixtures and screenshots are synthetic; no credentials, real chats or customer data are included.
- [ ] Scope, identity, revocation and failure behavior are considered where affected.
- [ ] Capability/support claims match the evidence; dependency/license changes retain notices and lockfiles.
- [ ] Commits are signed off with `git commit -s` under the Developer Certificate of Origin.

Use SECURITY.md for sensitive findings instead of this public form.
